name: branding-gradient-health-brand-profile-and-social-post-tiles
title: Gradient Health Brand Profile and Post
whatItIs: Two rounded tiles: a black tile holding a social profile card with a lilac cover and a gradient petal-person avatar, and a white-to-lilac tile with a large statement headline and the gradient wordmark.
whatItMeans: A soft gradient brand feels modern and caring, and showing both profile and post proves it works in the feed.
techniques: Black tile to make a light card glow
Gradient avatar as a brand stamp
Large left-aligned statement with a wordmark sign-off
Blur blobs of blue and violet in the post

vocabulary.definition: A social account page showing brand assets.
Lettering filled with a colour gradient.
A dark tile that makes a light element stand out.
